context: Tests whether the agent correctly maps a go.mod file to the golang language parameter (not 'go'), extracts module dependencies with their pinned versions, and formats the CLI invocation and report correctly.

checklist.name: golang language
checklist.description: Sets language to `golang` for Go module packages (not `go`, `gomod`, or `modules`)

checklist.name: go.mod extraction
checklist.description: Extracts dependency names and pinned versions from go.mod (e.g. github.com/gin-gonic/gin at v1.7.2)

checklist.name: JSON array format
checklist.description: Constructs a JSON array of `{language, name, version}` objects and pipes it to the CLI check command

checklist.name: npx check command
checklist.description: Invokes `npx @meterian/cli check` to run the scan

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with columns for Package, Version, Severity, ID, and Safe Versions

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line with vulnerability count and total packages checked
